overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter delivering premium spray dried jamun powder from India. Processed from selected ripe black plums, our ingredient retains natural color and authentic fruit essence. The advanced spray drying technique yields a fine powder with superior water solubility. This makes it suitable for complex formulations across modern manufacturing sectors.

Every batch undergoes a disciplined 6-step manufacturing process, ensuring rigorous quality inspection and moisture control below five percent. We offer complete export documentation support, samples on request, and an accessible minimum order quantity of five kilograms. Available for bulk supply or private label production, we provide custom mesh sizes and adaptable packaging configurations tailored to your specifications.
highlights: Spray dried processing for high solubility
Fine particle sizing of 80 to 100 mesh
Extended shelf life of 18 to 24 months
Free from external additives and carriers
packaging: 5 to 10 kg bags for mid-sized needs

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for this powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, supporting trial batches as well as commercial production volumes.

faqs.q: What are the standard technical specifications?
faqs.a: The powder features a particle size of 80 to 100 mesh, moisture content below 5 percent, and rapid dispersion in water.

faqs.q: Do you provide private label and custom packaging options?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer complete OEM and private label services, including retail pouches, jars, and customized mesh sizes on request.

faqs.q: What packaging configurations are available for bulk supply?
faqs.a: Bulk orders are packed in 25 kg bags or HDPE containers, with intermediate packaging available in 5 to 10 kg bags.

faqs.q: Can buyers request product samples before placing an order?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide ingredient samples on request to allow complete evaluation before commercial commitment.

faqs.q: What quality process governs manufacturing and dispatch?
faqs.a: Production follows a 6-step method: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch.
